chapter_title_en: Storm Rising Beyond the Seas; The Rebel Star Alliance
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal’s journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 508: Han Li Returns to a World at War – The Rebel Star Alliance
chapter_meta_description: Han Li learns the Chaotic Star Sea has erupted into civil war. The Rebel Star Alliance challenges the Star Palace. He must burn his trump card just to survive the journey home.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality – Ch. 508
og_description: The world has changed while Han Li was trapped in the Void Heaven Palace. A massive rebellion threatens the Star Palace's ancient rule.
twitter_title: RMJI 508: The sea is at war. Han Li has a terrible decision to make.
twitter_description: A quiet conversation reveals the Chaotic Star Sea is in chaos. Han Li must spend his rarest treasure just to stay ahead of the coming storm.

lore_anchors.definition: A newly formed alliance between the Righteous and Demonic paths, openly challenging the Star Palace’s rule over the Chaotic Star Sea.
A binding order from the Star Palace commanding all leaders to pay homage to the Twin Saint Masters.
The Rebel Star Alliance’s counterpart to the Heaven Star Token, threatening any who obey the Star Palace.
The supreme rulers of the Star Palace, said to have achieved mastery over the Primordial Magnetic Light.
An extremely rare liquid that instantly replenishes a cultivator’s mana; considered a last-resort treasure.
The current most powerful cultivator of the Demonic Path and one of the two leaders of the Rebel Star Alliance.
The Chief Protector of the Righteous Path’s Ten Thousand Laws Sect and the other leader of the Rebel Star Alliance.
An ancient treasure that enables extremely fast flight, used by Han Li in conjunction with the spirit milk to outpace the coming war.
